schemaDoc.purpose: Single source of truth for what is verified, observed or merely inferred across the SportsDesk/Fantasy402 docs release. P2 (spec generator) and P3 (markdown generator) must consume this instead of re-asserting contracts.

operationFields.path: Exact path string as published in docs/openapi.json.
operationFields.method: Lowercase HTTP method as in the spec.
operationFields.operationId: Spec operationId, or null where the spec omits it.
operationFields.tier: A | B | C | E for operations. D is reserved for surfaces[] rows (real surfaces absent from the spec), so counts.D is 0 by construction.
operationFields.capturedResponse: true only when a real captured response body exists in the repo or GS extract. False for every row in this release.
operationFields.evidence[]: Array of {source, kind, note}. source conventions in sourcePrefixes; source 'none' means no artifact exists.
operationFields.requiredCapture: The exact capture (or implementation) that would upgrade the row.
operationFields.contradicted: true when a spec assertion is refuted by a concrete artifact; contradictedReason carries the quotes.
operationFields.candidate_url: true when the path+method is a candidate inferred from UI/DOM metadata rather than observed on the wire.
operationFields.ui_observed: true when a UI/DOM artifact exists for the operation.

surfaceFields.id: Stable id; every id appears verbatim in docs/EVIDENCE.md.
surfaceFields.name: Human label.
surfaceFields.tier: D = real surface missing from the spec; E = documented operation with no implementation.
surfaceFields.missingFromSpec: true when docs/openapi.json has no row for this surface.

schemaDoc.counts: Operation counts by tier. A+B+C+D+E = total = 48. Surface counts are in surfaceCounts and are not mixed into counts.
schemaDoc.countsByTag: Operation tier counts per spec tag (convenience for P2/P3).

sourcePrefixes.(no prefix): Path relative to the worktree root /Users/nolarose/code/sportsdesk-ops/.worktrees/docs.
sourcePrefixes.main:: Read-only main tree /Users/nolarose/code/sportsdesk-ops (never edited by this task).
sourcePrefixes.fixture:: Committed fixture under the worktree; a shape sample, not a wire capture.

tierRules.A: Captured wire contract: a real request AND a real response capture exist. Eight operations qualify from the 2026-10-31/2026-11-01 live sessions (getWebLog, getInfoPlayer, getBetTicker, getBetTickerConfig, getSportsVigSetup, Pending, getTransactions, getGrading); see docs/evidence/captures/manifest.json. Earlier releases had none because the 2026-10-28 HAR captured only requests.
tierRules.B: Observed first-party evidence. (i) captured wire request: getWebLog mode B and getInfoPlayer (2026-10-28 Manager HAR); (ii) observed request payload: GS getBetReport; or (iii) a route this repository serves, verified against its handler source (GET /health, GET /api/watchlist, POST /api/telegram/alert, POST /api/telegram/report). Response bodies may still be uncaptured.
tierRules.C: Inferred only. Authored in docs/openapi.json or its generator scripts, or a repo TypeScript wire type, or a UI/DOM observation whose URL+method is a candidate. No request or response was observed.
tierRules.D: A real surface missing from the spec. Recorded in surfaces[], never in operations[].
tierRules.E: Documented operation with no implementation in this repository (/api/desk/*).
tierRules.crawlerCandidatesRule: B-vs-C rule for the 11 'Tracked Operational Domains' candidates (gameAdmin, getMessages, adjustBalance, createPlayer, get3rdPartyLimits, getAnalysis, getScores, getAgentTree, getBilling, getRules, getFinancialReport): a launcher tile alone is not enough for B. B requires a URL+method observed on the wire (or a handler that serves it). Those 11 rows take their path+method from hand-authored candidateEndpoint/candidateMethod constants in main:scripts/portal_tile_crawler.ts:40-162. The crawler CLI entry runs the offline branch (main:scripts/portal_tile_crawler.ts:670,680) and its live branch only replaces extracted inputs/L-keys, never the URL/method; no audit JSON or screenshot proof exists in the main tree. They are therefore tier C with candidate_url=true and ui_observed=true, never B. getAnalysis and getFinancialReport also have independent UI action-name evidence (runbook:166-167), which improves the tile evidence but does not observe the URL.

PINNED_EXPECTED_EMPTY_SUBSPORT_PATHS: stable Football/Coll Ext, Hockey/NCAA Extra, Horse Racing/Arena, Soccer/France Ligue; volatile LIVE/MMA Live, LIVE/WNCAA Live.

Six report kinds mapped to browser routes '/manager-tools/#/...' with contract status: transport unknown (last-bets: action getBetReport observed; HTTP transport and response unknown).
last-bets upstream: blocked_contract with url/method/contentType/responseSchema/authentication null; localInterfaces lists the CLI commands and marks notUpstreamEndpoints true.
Help text enumerates the runnable command surfaces; live report exits 2 with blocked_contract (:37).
'Keep live acquisition blocked until contract and critical authorization controls are verified.'

surfaces.note: The CLI itself is real and tested (6 Node tests in the extract); the report contracts are not. This mirrors the /manager-tools/ajax.php contradiction: the spec documents a wire contract the GS evidence explicitly says does not exist.

surfaces.name: /api/desk/* routes documented with no implementation
surfaces.what: 9 spec paths / 10 operations under /api/desk/* (auth session POST+DELETE, auth/me, hitl approve/queue/reject, forensics audit/scores, rfq quote/hedge) have no handler, no HMAC verifier, no CookieMap session code and no queue store anywhere in the repo.

evidence.note: Handler dispatches the known local routes and falls through to 404 (sportsdesk_webview_server.ts:299-307); no /api/desk prefix is matched.
The only /api/desk references outside the docs are the documentation tests asserting the spec contains them.
The routes were authored directly into docs/openapi.json by the generator; nothing implements them.

surfaces.note: E tier: these are operations in operations[] (tier E) and are also inventoried here so the release has one list. The 9 paths carry 10 operations because /api/desk/auth/session has both POST and DELETE.

surfaces.name: Live bets and its summary (GET /api/live-bets, GET /api/live-bets/summary)
surfaces.what: Derives a scoreboard payload from captured Report/Pending rows: games, agent rollup, and aggregates computed per request. Amounts stay in integer cents; Password/NameFirst/Login are stripped by name and the artifact builder refuses to write if any survive.

evidence.note: Both paths read the same rows through loadLiveBets() and call summarizeGames(), so the two responses cannot disagree. /api/f402/get-pending now answers 410 pointing here.

surfaces.requiredCapture: HTTP capture of GET /api/live-bets against a real Report/Pending capture; today the payload comes from data/live-bets.json (2 rows) and no HTTP response was captured.

surfaces.name: Agent hierarchy with wager rollup (GET /api/agent-tree)
surfaces.what: Serves data/agent-tree.json (2,276 agents, 4 roots) joined with per-agent exposure. Keys are canonical agentLoginKey values; a key owned by more than one AgentID is flagged and never given a level.

evidence.note: Reads the committed tree, computes counts from loadLiveBets().agents, and gates on piiRejection for non-loopback peers.

surfaces.requiredCapture: HTTP capture of GET /api/agent-tree (handler-verified only; no HTTP response was captured).

surfaces.name: Transcribed portal scoreboard (GET /api/scoreboard)
surfaces.what: Serves data/scoreboard.json: 22 games (NFL 12, NHL 5, NBA 4, NCAA 1) with scores, status and broadcast, transcribed from the manager page. The pasted logo column was offset, so logos are resolved by team name and verified against the CDN.

evidence.note: Returns the file plus summarizeScoreboard(); source and observedAt travel with the payload so a transcription is never mistaken for a capture.

surfaces.requiredCapture: A scoreboard API capture would replace the transcription; none exists, so the file carries source and observedAt instead.

surfaces.name: Sport taxonomy (GET /api/sports)
surfaces.what: The portal's 18 sport categories with counts for the loaded wagers and the scoreboard. All Sports is the absence of a filter and LIVE is a state, so neither is modelled as a category; unmapped sports surface as Other.

evidence.note: Counts are computed per request from loadLiveBets() and loadScoreboard(); lib/sport_taxonomy.ts holds the category list and the wire mappings.

surfaces.requiredCapture: HTTP capture of GET /api/sports (handler-verified only; no HTTP response was captured).

surfaces.name: Game Admin exposure (GET /api/game-admin)
surfaces.what: Exposure per fixture split by position (Straight/Parlay/Teaser), the report the portal manual v1.0.280 describes in F.A.Q. #4. preGame is computed from gameDateTime and is a fact about the fixture, not a claim about the operator's delete permission.

evidence.note: summarizeByGame() groups the captured wagers and compactPositions() drops empty buckets; position labels come from wagerTypeLabel().

surfaces.requiredCapture: HTTP capture of GET /api/game-admin (handler-verified only; no HTTP response was captured).

surfaces.name: Graph data plane (feed, companion JSON, assets)
surfaces.what: docs/graph.js fetches its data relative to the document, so the generated graph page was dead when served by the daemon. These paths serve it: the live feed at two paths, the two companion JSON files, and docs/assets/*.

evidence.note: All five families returned 404 before this route existed. Asset names are validated (separators, control characters, traversal) and traversal is rejected.

surfaces.requiredCapture: Not a capture gap: these are static files the graph page already ships. A capture would only restate their bytes.

surfaces.name: Analysis report (GET /api/analysis, /api/analysis/filters, /api/analysis/reports)
surfaces.what: The portal's Analysis report vocabulary and any transcribed result. The filter vocabulary is transcribed from report.js; a result is served only for the selection it was recorded under, and everything else answers 501 rather than zeroes.

evidence.note: parseAnalysisQuery validates the codes; matchesSelection gates the stored report; the 200 payload carries totals plus a recomputed copy and a discrepancies array.

The CP kind is the open question: an operator paste on 2026-11-01 shows a request with operation=getAgentPerformance and type=CP (tests/fixtures/f402-report-requests-observed-2026-11-01.json), which suggests the CP grid is served by getAgentPerformance rather than Report/getAnalysis; getReportPlayerAnalysis is the third candidate. Today one Customer Performance result (Baseball, agent BILLY666, 2026-11-01) is transcribed from an operator paste.

surfaces.name: Agent lookup for the Analysis form (GET /api/agents/search)
surfaces.what: Case-insensitive prefix-first search over the committed agent tree; used to offer agent suggestions instead of a free-text field that silently accepts typos. Loopback-gated like the tree itself, because agent names are identity data.

evidence.note: Requires q of at least two characters, clamps limit to 1..100, reads data/agent-tree.json, and returns key/level/agentType per hit.

surfaces.requiredCapture: Not a capture gap: the tree is committed. A capture would not change the contract.

surfaces.name: Game Admin board with per-side exposure (GET /api/game-admin/board)
surfaces.what: The Admin module of the portal's Game Admin report: each game's spread, moneyline, total and team-total lines with the money on each side. Amounts the portal abbreviates (120k) stay approximate and are excluded from every sum.

evidence.note: data/game-admin-board.json holds four transcribed games; filterByWindow applies the portal's 48/24/-1 window and biggestSide skips approximate figures.

surfaces.requiredCapture: A Game Admin API capture would replace the transcription; none exists, so the file carries source and observedAt.

surfaces.name: Sport catalog: sub-sports and period menus (GET /api/sports/catalog)
surfaces.what: 19 sports, 230 sub-sports and 42 period entries with the portal's own codes. Period numbers are sport-specific (1 is '1st Half' in Football, '1st Period' in Hockey, '1st 5 Innings' in Baseball), so the type index reports every name a number carries and flags the ambiguous ones.

evidence.note: Reads tests/fixtures/fantasy402-sport-catalog-2026-10-21.json; ?sport and ?subSport resolve an exact market, and unknown values 404 with the known list.

surfaces.requiredCapture: Not a capture gap: the catalog fixture is the captured artifact (capturedAt 2026-10-21, periods 2026-10-30).

surfaces.name: Contest / futures list (GET /api/contests)
surfaces.what: Every contest the sports nav links (data-action=get-games-prop), keyed by the portal's numeric contestNum with sport/market/subject parsed out of the padded type string.

evidence.note: data/contests.json is produced by scripts/extract_contests.ts from saved nav markup; ?group and ?q filter the list.

surfaces.requiredCapture: A contest API capture would replace the markup extraction; none exists.

surfaces.name: Live wager ticker list (GET /api/live-wagers)
surfaces.what: The {LIST: [...]} bet-ticker feed, which is a different shape from Report/Pending: WagerNumber is the ticket id, ShortDesc carries one line per leg, and VolumeAmount can differ from AmountWagered. Both grammars of ShortDesc are parsed; the compact one is flagged. The response also carries the file's own provenance (source, observedAt, captureNote, partial), so a salvaged subset cannot be read as the whole ticker.

evidence.note: lib/live_wagers.ts parses legs, classifies TicketWriter (GSLIVE/GSBUILDER/Internet/ALERT), flags volume mismatches, reads the file's provenance via readWagerListArtifact, and gates on piiRejection.

surfaces.requiredCapture: A full ticker capture. data/live-wagers.json currently holds 17 rows salvaged from a partial clipboard paste, and both its `partial: true` flag and its captureNote say so.
